title: Finite global stratification for a native adic constructible sheaf on a qcqs scheme
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. For any scheme $X$, let $B_X$ be the locally finite continuous $\Omega$-valued coefficient sheaf of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], applied on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ itself rather than on a geometric fibre, and let $\mathcal A(X)=\operatorname{Mod}(B_X)$. Use the same lisse and constructible conditions as that framework: lisse means pro-etale locally $B^{\oplus r}$ with $r$ finite and allowed to depend on the covering member; constructible means locally on the scheme a finite constructible locally closed partition with lisse restrictions. For a scheme morphism $f:Y\to X$, let $f^*M=B_Y\otimes_{f^{-1}B_X}f^{-1}M$, with the coefficient map induced by precomposition of functions. Let $X$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Every constructible $M\in\mathcal A(X)$ admits a finite stratification [def-constructible-stratification] of the whole scheme $X$ by constructible locally closed subschemes on each of which the restriction of $M$ is lisse. The empty scheme and zero ranks are allowed.

source.place: IsAdicConstructibleSheaf.isAdicStratifiedLisseSheaf, lines 127-198; exists_isAffineOpen, lines 108-125. The result assumes both CompactSpace X and QuasiSeparatedSpace X.

proof.text: By the constructibility condition in [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], applied on $X$ itself as in the statement, choose an open covering $X=\bigcup_\alpha V_\alpha$ and, on each $V_\alpha$, a finite constructible locally closed immersed partition $t_{\alpha b}:T_{\alpha b}\to V_\alpha$ such that $t_{\alpha b}^*(M|_{V_\alpha})$ is lisse. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-scheme-cofinal-finite-coverings] to this open covering: the assumed quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of $X$ give a finite affine open covering $W_a\subseteq V_{\alpha(a)}$. Enumerate its finite index set by $\operatorname{Fin}n$.

source.place: IsAdicConstructibleSheaf.exists_isAffineOpen and IsAdicConstructibleSheaf.isAdicStratifiedLisseSheaf, lines 108-198; geometric finite-chart refinement is supplied by the cited existing DAG lemma

proof.text: For each $a$, base change the partition of $V_{\alpha(a)}$ along the open inclusion $q_a:W_a\to V_{\alpha(a)}$. By [lemma-constructible-pullback-stratification] the schemes $R_{ab}=T_{\alpha(a)b}\times_{V_{\alpha(a)}}W_a$, with immersions $r_{ab}:R_{ab}\to W_a$, form a finite locally closed immersed stratification. Their images are the intersections of the original stratum images with $W_a$, hence are constructible in $W_a$ by [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-open-restriction]. Write $p_{ab}:R_{ab}\to T_{\alpha(a)b}$ for the first projections and $w_a:W_a\to X$, $v_\alpha:V_\alpha\to X$ for the inclusions. Pullback composition from [lem-sf-native-adic-pullback-exact-lisse] and $t_{\alpha(a)b}p_{ab}=q_ar_{ab}$ give $r_{ab}^*w_a^*M\cong p_{ab}^*t_{\alpha(a)b}^*v_{\alpha(a)}^*M$. The same cited node says that the pullback of a lisse object along any scheme morphism is lisse. Therefore every $r_{ab}^*w_a^*M$ is lisse.

source.place: IsAdicConstructibleSheaf.exists_isAffineOpen and IsAdicConstructibleSheaf.isAdicStratifiedLisseSheaf, lines 108-198; geometric finite-chart refinement is supplied by the cited existing DAG lemma

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-stratification-local-gluing-core] to the finite affine open cover $(W_a)_{a<n}$ and the finite constructible immersed stratifications $(R_{ab})_b$ just obtained. Its only scheme hypotheses are exactly that $X$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. It supplies a finite constructible locally closed immersed stratification $s_i:S_i\to X$ and, for each $i$, indices $a(i),b(i)$ and an actual scheme morphism $h_i:S_i\to R_{a(i)b(i)}$ such that $s_i=w_{a(i)}r_{a(i)b(i)}h_i$. Thus the refinement has scheme-theoretic factorizations, not just inclusions of its underlying images.

source.place: IsAdicConstructibleSheaf.exists_isAffineOpen and IsAdicConstructibleSheaf.isAdicStratifiedLisseSheaf, lines 108-198; geometric finite-chart refinement is supplied by the cited existing DAG lemma

proof.text: For each $i$, the composition comparison of [lem-sf-native-adic-pullback-exact-lisse] identifies $s_i^*M$ with $h_i^*(r_{a(i)b(i)}^*w_{a(i)}^*M)$. The object in parentheses is lisse by step 2, and the same node gives lissity after pullback by $h_i$. The stratification supplied in step 3 therefore has all the required lisse restrictions, and it is a stratification in [def-constructible-stratification]. When $X$ is empty, take instead the empty indexed family, whose partition and restriction conditions are vacuous. No argument assumes positive or constant rank: the pullback assertion preserves each finite rank, including zero, on each covering member.
